analysis.evidence: Pharaoh asks Abram why he said אֲחֹתִי הִוא (“She is my sister”). The words immediately following אָמַרְתָּ quote Abram’s statement.
analysis.morphology: Qal perfect, second person masculine singular. The ending ־תָּ marks the subject “you.”
